HEADLINE
3x conversion rates from new customers

SUBHEADLINE
Marketing VPs at mid-sized B2B companies get authentic customer stories for fueling campaigns.

WHAT THIS IS
A tool that helps marketing vps at mid-sized b2b companies move from no authentic customer stories to 3x increase in conversion rates.

WHO IT IS FOR
Marketing VPs at mid-sized B2B companies

THE PROBLEM
No authentic customer stories to fuel marketing campaigns

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Manual video recording and editing was designed for broader categories, not specific needs of marketing vps at mid-sized b2b companies.

HOW IT WORKS
AI-powered conversation starters replace scripted questions.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach first outcomes without general-purpose alternatives' overhead.

CALL TO ACTION
Start collecting video testimonials.
